landmark.text: Azeth's Rest is a client village of House Azeth, the merchant house of Kurn. It is built around a lush oasis along the trade road that connects the north to the south, and serves a stop-over point for caravans going to and coming from the Tyr region. This walled village features a sizeable legion of mercenaries to guard against the frequent raids from the west. Raiders from the Bandit States often target caravans traveling on the road, and even strike at the village when their need is particularly great. Azeth's Rest welcomes all other travelers - provided they can pay the fees for using its services.
